> [!module|walk] A walk in the park

A made-up booklet for the compiler's reading helpers: tabs inside tabs, citation notes, folds and a hint. It follows one short walk.[^trail] Pick the plan first, then read what to do on the path.[^bench]

> [!tab|plan] Plan

Choose a route and pack the bag before you set out.

> [!tab|during] During

Keep to the path and watch the weather.

> [!activity|route tab:plan] Choose a route

Three loops start at the gate.

> [!tab|short] Short loop

A short loop takes twenty minutes and stays on the flat. See also [[#Hilly loop]].

> [!tab|long] Long loop

The long loop circles the pond and takes an hour.[^pond]

> [!note]- Wet ground
> After rain the far side of the pond is soft.

> [!tab|hilly] Hilly loop

The hilly loop climbs to the lookout and back.

> [!tip]- Take poles
> Walking poles help on the steep stretch.

Pack light.


> [!note]- A thermos
> Hot tea keeps well for an hour.

> [!tip]- A hat
> A brim keeps the sun off.

> [!choice|snack] Which snack will you carry?
- [ ] Apple
- [ ] Biscuit
- [ ] Nuts

> [!hint]- Hint
> Choose what is easy to eat while walking.

> [!solution]- Solution
> There is no wrong snack.


## Birds you may see

A robin, a thrush, perhaps a heron by the pond.

[^trail]: *The Park Trail Book*, 2nd edition (2019), p. 12: "Start at the east gate." Verified 2026-09-14.
[^bench]: *A Walker's Almanac*, p. 88: "Rest where the view opens."
[^pond]: *The Park Trail Book*, 2nd edition (2019), p. 31: "The pond path is flat but long."

> [!module|walk end] End of A walk in the park
